questions.subject: RAG
questions.question: Explain the difference between vector database and chunking strategies in RAG.
questions.ideal_answer: vector database and chunking strategies differ in several ways: vector database is semantic search storage (works by embedding-based retrieval) whereas chunking strategies is document segmentation (works by optimal retrieval unit size). vector database is typically used for FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Milvus, while chunking strategies is used for fixed size, semantic, recursive, agentic. Example demonstrating vector database: indexing: IVF, HNSW, flat. Example demonstrating chunking strategies: chunk_size=512, chunk_overlap=50.
